title: Coca Cola Meatballs

items.prep: minced very fine in chopper, divided

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Spray a 20 x 30 cm (8 x 12 inch) oven dish with cooking spray.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, water, half of the very finely minced onion, the salt for the meatballs, and the black pepper for the meatballs. Mix well and form into balls; place in a single layer in the prepared oven dish.

In a small bowl, mix together the remaining very finely minced onion, the dash of salt for the sauce, and the few dashes of black pepper for the sauce. Add the garlic, tomato sauce, Coca-Cola, and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over the meatballs.
Bake 50-60 minutes (turning twice), until the sauce is bubbly and the meatballs are fully cooked.
